description: Agent Claims: submit a first notice of loss with the policy it claims under: the notice with its claim number, the policy number it cites, the claimant, the day of the loss, the day notice was given, the cause of loss it reports and its description; the policy with its number, each named insured, each additional insured, listed driver or other covered party, the first and last day of the policy period, each peril it covers, each peril it excludes and the days after the loss by which it requires notice. The signed report gives the notice and the policy, the loss date against the policy period, the reported peril against the perils the policy excludes and those it lists as covered, the claimant against the named insureds and covered parties, and the day notice was given against the deadline the notice window sets, with the days late, and counts them, and names a divergent notice: an incident date outside the policy period, a peril the policy excludes or does not list, a claimant who is not a named insured or covered party, and notice given after the policy’s notice window; then another policy number, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A notice with no loss date, no cause of loss or no claimant, or a policy with no period, no perils, no insured or no notice window leaves the notice unverified. Perils read by their words with plurals folded, parties without case, punctuation or a legal suffix, and the deadline in whole days from the loss. This reads the notice actually filed against the policy: wever_insurance-claims-deadline-check computes the deadlines a policy sets for an incident, its notice and proof-of-loss deadlines among them, while the fnol check reads the first notice of loss as filed against the policy and those deadlines, for the period, the peril, the claimant and when notice came. Verdict claims_fnol_divergent, claims_fnol_partial, claims_fnol_unverified or claims_fnol_consistent. POST /api/claims-fnol-check. Reads the claim records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between claim documents only: it never files or submits a claim, never negotiates or pays one and never decides coverage, which stays with the insurer, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Claims reads claim records across the claim lifecycle for consistency between the claim documents and the policy they claim under: a first notice of loss, a sworn proof of loss, an adjuster’s report, a repair or replacement estimate, a settlement offer and release, a denial letter, a subrogation demand and a claim payment record, each against the policy, the first notice, the inspection record and claim file, the approved scope, the claim valuation, the claim record, the payment record or the settlement or adjudication it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral across property, casualty and liability claims and reads different claim documents against each other and against the policy. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-claims-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-claims/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

claimant.description: The person or business making the claim.

description.description: The loss as the notice describes it.

loss_date.description: The day the incident happened, such as 2026-10-15.

peril.description: The cause of loss the notice reports, such as water damage or collision.

policy_number.description: The policy number the notice claims under.

ref.description: The claim number the notice opens, such as CLM-2026-0412.

reported_on.description: The day notice of the loss was given to the insurer, such as 2026-10-15.

covered_parties.description: Each additional insured, listed driver, household member or other covered party the policy names.

covered_perils.description: Each peril or cause of loss the policy covers, when it lists them.

effective_on.description: The first day of the policy period, such as 2026-10-15.

excluded_perils.description: Each peril or cause of loss the policy excludes.

expires_on.description: The last day of the policy period, such as 2026-10-15.

named_insureds.description: Each named insured on the policy.

notice_days.description: The days after the loss by which the policy requires notice.

number.description: The policy number on the policy.
